name: Zechariah (son of Hosa)
title: Temple guard from the clan of Merari
summary: Zechariah was the son of Hosa, from the clan of Merari, and served as a gatekeeper at the house of the Lord during the time of David. He is described as a wise counselor.

keyEvents.title: Temple Gatekeeper
keyEvents.description: Zechariah, son of Hosa, was appointed as the gatekeeper for the north gate at the house of the Lord.
